steps.name: Orbital Chaos
steps.objective: After talking to Shino in "Midgard", go to "Space Shuttle Station".

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I heard the circumstances to some extent. We will take the princess to Aoichi as soon as she recovers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: It seems very confusing. It's hard for me to say anything about what you do.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: What are you going to do now? Wasn’t there something you used to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Looking for Iris… .

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Ah, Iris… . Iris I don't know where you are now, but I'll tell you where you went.
(Sino points upward with his finger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Above? ceiling? Ah, the sky.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I remember talking about this while eating with my colleagues here. They say that if you go up to the sky and meet the As gods, you can find out something... .

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: They were people full of will. I also remember meeting a person named Siam here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the Ass gods... .

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: They are the people who spread science to Gendia, including Midgard. Some of Midgard's residents are also descendants of the As gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I'm not sure exactly, but try climbing to the top of Bifrost. I heard that there is a machine there that can take you to space, the home of the As gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then I'll go right away. Thank you for your words.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: What? Come and have a meal over there. You're already gone.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: … For some reason, if it's that person, I might meet Iris soon... .

steps.name: Hello beyond the vacuum?!
steps.objective: After talking with [Scura], go to the hanger. Defeat [Garter] at the hanger.

lines.text: (As you enter the Bifrost, you see a huge spaceship.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, something like this really happened. Can I go to Asgard just by riding this?
(I feel a hint of popularity from somewhere. A girl sees %s and takes a step back in surprise.)
Wow, there are people in a place like this... . That Scura, the branch manager! I really can't believe it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you saying?

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Oh, are you coming to take a spaceship to Asgard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. But can you really go?

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Of course, sir!! I was finally able to go after 16795%% hours, 32 minutes and 33 seconds since I came here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many hours?!

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Don't worry about that!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm really nervous...)

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: The shuttle to Asgard is leaving soon! Passengers, please board quickly!

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Scura will kindly guide you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess I'm really happy.)

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Uh, why are you looking at me like that? Is this your first time seeing an astronaut with octopus legs?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Although this is my first time seeing an octopus-legged astronaut, the reason I saw Skura was because he seemed happy.

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Hehe, I'm really happy.

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: You've seen strange monsters, birds covered in flames, and dragons, but the octopus-legged girl isn't that fascinating, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. haha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know that I met such beings??

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Ahaha… . The space shuttle is leaving! Dear guest, I hope you reach your destination comfortably. Enough with Skura!
(Scura's guidance message to be careful inside the shuttle rings out. Then, the door of the shuttle, which has stopped moving, opens with a loud sound.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this Asgard? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a space where a small spaceship seems to be attached to a huge spaceship... .
Ahem. It’s no wonder you feel that way!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Skura? How is Skura here?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: I look a bit like it, but I'm not Skura! By Skura, do you mean the beautiful and innocent girl at Bifrost Station?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Then you are mistaken!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if you roll forward or backward, it's a skew line, right?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Ahem! Where are you looking! There's no way such a cute and lovely girl could have a solemn and handsome beard!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, it means that if you were me, you would have crossed space faster than a spaceship and arrived here.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Shocked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shocked?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Ahem, nothing! This is all your illusion! Hehe, then, go and see what you have to do in Asgard.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: I'm having a hard time coming so I think I need to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then take a break. But where can I go from here to meet other people?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: If you find the way and go inside, you can meet someone named Ishtar!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Ah! It will be easier to go by destroying broken mechas as you go. No, it will be easy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For a moment, I think my tone of voice changed...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … How did it come to be like this?
(A being that appears to be Skura? …steps back and waves its hand, avoiding %s’s answer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think he's saying something... What? Just go for it.
(Scura from afar? … nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Phew, I can't help it. then… . Let’s go meet someone named Ishtar… .

steps.name: Asgard's helper
steps.objective: Talk to [Ishtar] in the “compartment” and kill [Fenrir].

lines.text: (A passage leading somewhere can be seen behind many mecha.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There you are. But this sound… ? This is... .
(Click. Click. The sound of the machine running is on the floor. There are parts of a machine that appears to have been destroyed on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is the remains of the mecha we saw here. Did a battle just happen here...? ? I can also smell the smell of scorched artillery shells.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are also traces of fighting monsters... .
Who is there? This is my first time hearing your voice... .
(From inside, a woman wearing unusual armor can be seen. After a while, the woman approaches in a floating state, relying on the armor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you?
Stop. If you do anything suspicious, I will turn you into dust. Saraswati, why?
(The image of someone named Saraswati appears next to the woman, vaguely like a hologram.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Sister Ishtar, please wait a moment. That person is not from the earth. The system is causing chaos. Probably the same as back then.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: When a man named Siam came?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Who are you? Who are you and why are you making an error here? Its very existence is questionable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say Siam? A companion of Iris?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Do you even know? Iris… . It's a name I haven't heard in a long time. So, why are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Ishtar that you came here to find the whereabouts of Iris.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: You were the error that Saraswati noticed a while ago.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's certainly strange that an unrecognized being has been recognized, but now the system recommends that we trust that person... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Adventurer… looking for Iris . No, maybe Iris called it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Even if we explained it, you wouldn't understand right away.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Ah, Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, sister.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I will do as Saraswati says. What is your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: %s… , no see.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Okay. We, the Asgardian Defense Force, welcome you as a <helper>. I am Ishtar. I am in charge of commanding the Asgard defense line.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Her nickname is Ishtar... Just do it to that extent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Ishtar. nice to meet you. But a helper?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Please cooperate for a moment. Then you will be able to reach what you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will do that. So what should we do?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: This place is complicated now because of beings from unknown places. So I was looking into that, and you showed up and things changed a little bit.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I don't know exactly what to say, but anyway. Now I have to look at the system around here.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: So I want to ask you a favor. Could you please go back the way you came and take a look again?

steps.name: Code name Elmay
steps.objective:
1. Meet [Broken Belt] in the “Hanger” and hear the story about [Ishtar].
2. After talking to [Ishtar] in the "compartment", go back to where the [Broken Belt] is and talk to her.

lines.text: (In the distance, you can see a stopped mecha. The mecha seems to be feeling the presence of people and is operating with difficulty.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think it's okay because it's broken... but it feels different from the runaway type...)

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Crackling… . Approaching unrecognized object.

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Neither a being from Asgard nor a monster from another world... .

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Just like Siam... . Crackling… . Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Do you recognize me? Ah, maybe Ishtar told me to come see it...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found Iris and… .

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: You are talking about Iris who came with Siam. Crackling… .

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Create a temporary account. Temporarily register the target's account in the [ally] category... . I am a belt type angel with identification number SB7-37. Please call me [Elmay]. Crackling… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elmay, nice to meet you. I am %s… , Is Elmei okay now?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . After a long battle, the limit has been reached. Crackling… . Since it is a prototype, it is not surprising if it becomes inoperable at any time in its current state... .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Ishtar, are you okay? Crackling… . Monsters that I don’t even know when and where they appeared… . We fought against an attack by beings that were not accidental... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ishtar is fine. Ah, Elmay. I'll take you to Ishtar.

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . My weight is about three times that of %s... . Please don’t overdo it… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . After all, kind people like them... Then, could you please talk to Ishtar and bring her an AI booster?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: This is a device that extends my preservation function for a certain period of time. If you have that, you can recover after ejecting the core unit if Ishtar looks at it. Crackling… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will come right away.

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . %s’s face overlaps with Iris… . My colleague Siam also comes to mind… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, don't overdo it. I'll be back soon!

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: I… When I recover... I too, who was with them... For you... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: %s, did anything happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Elmei’s story to Ishtar.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Elmay! thank god. He was still alive. thank god. A warrior who fought many battles together... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's awesome.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Incident 2 years ago... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Two years ago... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: So much time has already passed... . Because of an incident two years ago, we ended up producing belts that had been used for about 5,000 cycles up to 20,000.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I have to protect this place. Otherwise, G&Dia beyond here might become dangerous... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Elmay is an early model, number 37. Oh, that's right. Elmei said you needed something, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's called an AI booster.
(As soon as Ishtar hears it, he gives an item that appears to be an AI booster in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Be sure to tell that to that child. Elmei, who was my mother's angel, was my favorite person along with my mother. He was a special kid, so I made up his own name.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Sister… It feels the same. I really want to meet you again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you cherish it, so I’ll hurry. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . Time's up. There was an error of about 147 seconds... .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: It's a shame. It's strange. ah. This can't be a system error.

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: The state I feel in the system is... .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Do humans call this fear? Or sadness… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Or loneliness… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Are these the emotions humans are talking about?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry we won't be able to meet again. Thank you… I had to tell you everything... .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . Crackling… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . It may be impossible, but the previous master... . I want to meet Ishtar’s parents… .

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Crackling… . I heard that Ishtar has grown wonderfully since we met... . Crackling… . Proud of you two... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I’m back, Elmay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elmay… ?
(Elmay's movements have stopped. Even the voice that felt like he was desperately missing his master cannot be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This can't be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's late... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to know. The work of Iris and the work of this place... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this… .
(There is a small chip in front of Elmei.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what it is. Let's take care of it and go to Ishtar... . Elmay… .

steps.name: cross world (1)
steps.objective:
1. After talking to [Ishtar] in the 'compartment', kill [Kudori] in the 'hydroponic farm'. 
2. Go to [Freya] in the “compartment”. Then, defeat [Loki] wandering around “D-Labo” to obtain <Loki’s Black Feather>.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work, %s. But why is your expression like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elmay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ishtar that Elmei has stopped operating. Then deliver the chip obtained near Elmei.)
(Ishtar is speechless with a shocked expression.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Elmay… . Elmay… .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I'm sorry, and thank you... . I will go and retrieve the remains of Elmei later once this is over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Ishtar.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: … I really hate this situation right now. I can't even afford to be sad... . You have to defeat the monsters that keep appearing and fix the broken mechas.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Saraswati is looking for the cause, but I don't know how long it will take.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Ishtar? What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Sorry, wait. I have a message to convey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll wait a moment.
(Ishtar begins to talk to herself as if sending a message somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Freya… . Is there anything wrong there? Nothing wrong? There is something slightly wrong... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Don't be weird. I asked if there was anything wrong. Why are you saying that now? Even though the timing was ambiguous... .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Phew… .  Hey, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Saraswati and Freya say they have something to talk about. Would you like to go? On the way, I hope that they will also deal with the farm mechas that run away at the hydroponic farms... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, you can do it right away.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Freya's personality is unusual, so she might hold on to her for a long time, so cut her off appropriately. Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What Saraswati wants to say is… .

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Maybe you're looking for... .
(An incredibly loud explosion is heard from the direction of the hydroponic farm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I guess we'll have to hurry. I will go and hear that from Saraswati.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Yeah... .
(In another space beyond the hydroponic farm, a girl with a playful expression is dancing as if she doesn't feel like she's popular.)
Jang jaga jaga jaga, jang jaga jaga jaga! Umm, people? Haha, it’s human ♡
It's a person! person! A person other than Ishtar!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Freya?
(The girl suddenly stands at attention and salutes.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Please don’t just stay silent and accept my salute!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I accept it?
(Freya looks satisfied with %s's reaction to unexpectedly receiving a salute.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Freya… ?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: A colony in space! Who's coming here?! Pursuing spiritual care in a corner of the colony! Even though it's hard, keep planting lettuce! ♬

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: The colony's idol, Freya! Freya, the sorrowful female warrior! It's full of hidden kindness! I'm completely in love with the inorganic mechanics!  ♬

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: The main character who surpasses Ishtar’s sister!! That’s Freya! Ah, this is a mistake♥

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It strangely rhymes... .

lines.speaker: 지나가던 커돌이
lines.text: Freya, what did you just say...

lines.speaker: 지나가던 커돌이
lines.text: Idol, kind, sad, in love?
(Freya looks at Keudori with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Pass by quietly. Otherwise, I'll rip the memory chip.

lines.speaker: 커돌이
lines.text: Ah, yes. I'm just a guy passing by!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why is everything like this here?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, come to your senses. Hey Freya,

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came here after dealing with the mechas that were running away at the hydroponic farm.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Woohi, thank you. Would you like some carrots?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, black carrots? Purple Carrot… ? Well, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Sheesh, did you notice!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you put in the carrots?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe, anyway, I can't help it because you don't eat carrots. I have a favor to ask you☆ On the way to the space where Saraswati is, strange guys appeared.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Loki has appeared in D-Labo!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I don't know why Loki, a god from another world, appeared, but he's playing around here.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Please catch it first. Once we get what Loki has, Saraswati will figure out the cause.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: That way, you will be able to find the answer you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say Loki?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will look for it.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha! Then eat the carrots and go. It will give you strength.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't have red carrots, it's okay. See you later, Freya.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha! yes!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Come out Kerdol. Keodori, kudori, this is Freia.

lines.speaker: 다시 돌아온 커돌이
lines.text: Yes, I am Keodori back again. Freya, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Big turn, big turn? Have you ever seen a red carrot?

lines.speaker: 다시 돌아온 커돌이
lines.text: Well… .

steps.name: cross world (2)
steps.objective: After talking to [Saraswati] in the "compartment", find the mental empathizer in "D-Labo". And approach the unknown boy and girl.

lines.text: (At the very end of D-Labo, in the center of the new compartment, a girl can be seen looking at a holographic screen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Are you here? I was waiting. Please wait there for a moment.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Super space-time network opening... H-E-L-L-O. welcome.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I am Saraswati, and you are %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you know me well. The thing I said earlier about being an earthly person... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The construction network was watching your performance as important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? You were looking at me... ?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Although it is limited to GENDIA... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asgard's scientific power is amazing.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Maybe there is a different side to it than you think.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If that makes sense, I would like to see the <Super Time-Space Network> itself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't Saraswati a human being?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It is clear that you were born as a human... . Our clan is a clan that declared that they would abandon their bodies and take over the world of the Electronic Galaxy as their territory.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Although I was a human, I thought my body as a human was meaningless... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's difficult. It's different from many places in Gendia, and I understand that Atlantis' scientific power is sealed... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes. The hasty dissemination of scientific power led to many tragedies.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s said you were looking for Iris. Then about Iris… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: First of all, would you please give me what you asked for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. here… .
(Delivering Loki’s items to Saraswati.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This item can only be obtained by people like Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by that?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I can't tell you that far. It is not within the range permitted by the system. New protocol opened... .
(Loki's objects in Saraswati's hands are absorbed into the screen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…It’s incredible technology….)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Wait… . What is this? %s, have you seen anything other than Loki in D-Labo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were strange kids running around.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: As expected, the energy of a strange dimension appeared in that way.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, the only pure humans in the space we are in are %s and Ishtar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then those children... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It may be Giendia from another dimension, or a human from Asgard from another dimension. Being able to meet and talk with them now... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Only %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: can i do it?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Iris If you came here after me, you can do it.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like you to meet them. Because words may not make sense... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Mental empathy… You can go to them with this. That's what the beings in D-Labo have.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will they meet you?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you can communicate, it will be okay.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: After that, I'll tell you what I wanted to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, if it's something that only I can do, I'll do it.
(A boy and a girl who can talk become alert when they see the approaching figure of %s.)

lines.speaker: 언노운 소녀
lines.text: Green, be careful.

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: That guy doesn't seem to have any intention of fighting. Am I right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The closer I get, the more I seem to be able to understand... . Let's give it a mental empath. Here’s this in my hand, here’s what’s in my hand… .
(The boy looks at %s's actions and nods his head. The moment the mental empathy device in %s's hand was transferred to the boy's hand, I feel like my mind is clearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? It's true.

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: Oh, I can hear it. Through words.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… Words make sense!

lines.speaker: 언노운 소녀
lines.text: Really! Hear me! Amazing! I guess this is a translation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm %s, I'd like to talk to you guys.

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: After all, that person wasn’t a doppelganger!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doppelganger?

lines.speaker: 언노운 소녀
lines.text: Ah, this is not the time. Let me introduce myself. I'm Ruby!

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: I'm Kai.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: So what should we talk about? Delicious dessert?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Ruby, I don't think so. %s… , what is the story you want to tell?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You guys also came here looking for Iris, right?

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Who is Iris? Do you know, Ruby?

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Sorry, that's a name I've never heard of.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't you know Iris? The girl from the Der tribe who defeated the demon king two years ago... . I came looking for such Iris... . Not you guys?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: I don’t think there was anyone like that in Mr. Lin’s group… .

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Of course, the Grand Duchess of Frost Castle, Trista, Shaman Sati, Sea Dragon King Ahyul, Agashura Hunter Owen, and Dragon Knight Rin! These people are everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There are a lot of names I’ve never heard before….)

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: This is a story that even children in the capital [Parangis] know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bluegis? Where is it… .

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Don’t you know about the capital, Farangis?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: I think the story from earlier was strange.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: I can guess something from the conversation I had with Sarah earlier. Now, let me tell you about us first.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: One day, we had a dream. It was a dream about a person named ‘Owen’ fighting the devil.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: They were able to defeat the Demon King, but Lin, who was the leader of the group until then, was seriously injured and captured by Agashura.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: The other party members were also in danger of being attacked by Agashura... Right then! Oh my goodness, the Demon King used his last strength to save everyone except Sister Lin!

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: In fact, the Demon King was assimilated into Sister Lin... .

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: It is said that he summoned us when the Demon King disappeared and the balance between light and darkness was broken, putting the world at risk of destruction.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: I still vividly remember setting off on an adventure with countless Adventurer in Belos village to save Sister Lin and Zendia!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Belos… It seems like the Belos I know is correct, but it’s not….)

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: This is a story we all know... . %s, don't you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. then… . It's difficult.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Ah, I see!

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Yeah, that's it too. Just like Sarah said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to say that we are people from different worlds, right?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Huh? Another world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demon Lord, I know Agashura, but the story is different starting from the village Belos. I have no idea who Ruby was talking about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll check with you guys one more time. Iris, Kazno, Muwen, Zoe, Elias… Have you ever heard of

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: I still don’t know… .

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: As Saraswati said, it seems like parallel worlds overlap. Are we talking about objects with similar frequencies among <Unknown> copied in different worlds?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , I guess Saraswati is there too. I am also unknown to you right now... I guess it looks like this.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Ugh, it's complicated.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Kai, you can't do that. Try to understand.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Anyway, you are traveling to defeat Agashura, right? You're here for that girl named Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I find Iris… . uh?
(A hologram of Saraswati appears in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s responded… please. Can you hear me? If there is a being from another world in front of them, please do not tell them that I spoke to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, yes. I will.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: %s, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please come back quickly. The dimensional stability of your current location is rapidly decreasing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the story?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you do it wrong, you may fall into a gap in construction. This is a very dangerous situation. Please get out quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… .

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: … Looks like something happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, I guess I have to go. This place… .

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: We have that much sense too. I think we should move too... I'm so sad that we're breaking up.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Goodbye. You have to be careful. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, you two are doing well... . I hope we can meet again someday.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Hello, see you again!

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Goodbye.
(With the greeting, Ruby and Kai's appearance changes from an unknown appearance to an innocent boy and girl, and then disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... . Is this what children are like? In that world… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, let’s go to Saraswati quickly. You'll find out when you go. What the hell is this place… .

steps.name: Hell's Door
steps.objective: After talking to [Saraswati] in the "compartment", enter "Hell's Door" and defeat [Hel]. 'After defeating [Hel], move to the next area.

lines.text: (In a room filled with strange air, Saraswati is concentrating while watching the letters moving on the screen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati, I am here. Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: For now, it's okay. And thank you for obtaining a valuable record of my conversation with them.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Parallel World… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Is it like a shadow of this world, or is it another world that stands on equal footing with us? .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Although it is not exact, this is the first time that such direct evidence has been obtained.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It was a really strange feeling. The experience of talking to another world I didn't know about and the people who live there... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And I have something to tell you. About the door right in front of you.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Currently, a powerful being from another dimension is blocking the entrance to the area between D-Labo and Yggdrasil.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Yes?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Its powerful power is enough to transform the world itself. As of now, Record and Quarry are stopping it with their efforts...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: … I guess we'll just have to wait and see.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I can't waste time. The current state of the dimension is extremely unstable. Because of the dimension Loki was in... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If the space-time stability of our world is poor, it may lead to a conflict between our world and the surrounding world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Chu… Crash? Then… What happens?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: … Well, I don't know. What is certain is that something needs to be done before that happens.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: So there is a need to normalize Yggdrasil's facilities.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, I would like you to defeat [Hel], the goddess of hell in Hell's Door and normalize the area.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Then maybe… . %s may find the answer you are looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The answer I want... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, good luck.
(Inside a space full of unknown ominous energy, a space that feels like hell, a woman with an unusual appearance is waiting for guests.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like hell here. That person is... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The Raven's son has come this far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you're mistaking me for someone else... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You want to protect this disgusting city of gods. But I can't leave it like that.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: How can you still be alive when you were killed by a tree branch?!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: It doesn't matter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Son of light. If you will defy fate and fight against me, I will make you a resident of my territory with my own hands!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The final twilight of the world and the gods begins... !!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hahahahahaha!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a huge fear... . But, I can do it. I need to get an answer. So I have to deal with you. Even if it’s just an unknown situation like this… .
(Hel's movement stops due to %s's attack. In addition, it feels like the ominous energy is receding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is it over?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Huh? What happened? My head feels refreshed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The atmosphere has changed... . you?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Thanks to you, my mind became clearer. thank you.
(Hel approaches and kisses %s on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah, it's a match. If you suddenly do this, no, I'd be surprised!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You're not used to this kind of thing. Hehehe.
(The woman who felt like the goddess of hell is now smiling brightly as if that has nothing to do with it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's beautiful.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Thank you. My introduction is late. … I am Hel, the youngest of Loki's three siblings, and the goddess of destiny who will bring an end to everything.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: When the dimensional door suddenly opened and I came to this place, I think I was captured by a <space-time bug> in the gap between space and time.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Sorry, I was out of my mind for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So are you saying that the current fight was unintentional?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Yes, I originally announced destruction to everything in the world when the ‘Twilight of the Gods’ period came... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: She is a goddess with a mission to guide humanity as it is reborn in a time of new rebirth. So I don’t act in places that are unrelated to my mission.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: My brothers and my father, Loki, too. I don't know if that's why he looked after you.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe, <Deceiver> Loki is, after all, the brother of the highest god. He is a being that no one can touch before fate strikes him down.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Well, that too is a story from our world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe, thank you. Then, brave young man, continue on your way. I decide to wait until the dimension stabilizes and return to my hometown.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Don't worry, I will lead your father and brothers who have been causing trouble as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I can only be thankful that a divine being has relieved me of the shame of being caught up in a lowly bug.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you're a good person.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Let's meet again. Brave traveler!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: No matter how confused I was, I, the queen of the underworld, could mistake an ordinary human being for a child of light... .

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe, I think I can understand a little bit about the role that traveler plays in this world... .

steps.name: open the door
steps.objective: After talking with [Record & Query Brothers], take the portal and enter the “Gap in Time and Space.”

lines.text: (A place where time feels as if it has stopped. As soon as you enter, you feel an inexplicable sense of heterogeneity. Where your eyes are focused, two young men with a strange feeling are blocking entry.)
Please wait a moment.
Stop, stop! It's better not to come in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You… .

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: I'm Record, and this is my younger brother, Quarry...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: We are the managers of Yggdrasil. Well, it's temporarily closed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati said… . Oh, I'm %s… no see.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: That's the kid I was talking about. Welcome. To Yggdrasil.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Query, please be polite.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Hey, this is okay. Hmm, what should we talk about? Thanks to you, I survived, so I’ll listen to anything. Unless it’s something like a confession!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to meet Iris. Iris… . Oh, do you know someone named Iris?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Of course. Iris Ms.… .

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: I see. You are the Adventurer who appeared because Iris called.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Call of Iris… .

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: This is my first time seeing the real thing... . Hmm, that’s interesting and fun.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: What are you having fun with, Quarry? What should I do to come to my senses?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are two people... . I was sure that if Saraswati came here, I would be able to get the answer I wanted... .

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: It's not wrong.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Okay, I don't know if this is the answer you're looking for, but I can help you. Iris The space where the sheep arrived… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I would like you to tell me the entrance into it. Is that also Yggdrasil? If possible, please allow me to pass through there... .

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Well, I'm sorry about this. It's right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W… here?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Yeah. Here is the entrance.
(Query raises his hand high)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, here, this space itself... .

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Hel said he was grateful to %s for helping him come back to his senses and decided to cooperate with us.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: This may not be a problem, but restoring an already eroded dimension is a different matter.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: It will take some time... I'm sorry about this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is a story of force majeure, so there is nothing we can do about it.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: I'm really sorry... But I promise you this one thing.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: I will do my best to restore the door to this place, risking our brother's honor. So, calm down and wait just a moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: We are grateful. Uh huh.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Huh? It was over sooner than expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Suddenly, the stabilization of the dimension progressed at a rapid pace, and this... .

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Should I call it a variable or like a virus?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: I think it's all because of you, no, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: %s, the space beyond was opened once in the past... . I can't say that then and now are the same.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Let me ask you again. Do you still want to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: I enjoyed that belief.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Okay, I opened the door. Move forward. The answer you wanted... .

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: You will be able to meet the person with the answer inside the door to that dimension.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Good luck!

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Me too... .
